title: Postpartum Support: Can we Facilitate the Transition to Motherhood?
brief_summary: We are conducting a study to look interventions that may reduce stress in the postpartum period for first- time mothers. One of these interventions is an educational film that describes the common stressors that first-time parents go through in the early postpartum period. The other is a hotline service that women can call at anytime during the first 3 months postpartum to ask about problems she or the baby may be experiencing.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy first-time mothers with singleton baby delivered at term with no complications.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Mothers with chronic health problems,
* Pregnancy complications, OR
* Infants with congenital problems or conditions requiring admission to the intensive care nursery.
